name: Butterfield
verdict: The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited, a Bermuda bank listed on the NYSE and the Bermuda Stock Exchange. Nothing found.
aliases: The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited
note: Official Offshore Financial Services Partner of the NorthStar SailGP Team in a three-and-a-half-year agreement signed in July 2025 (SailGP press release, 18 Jul 2025). Rating note (2026-10-03): Butterfield is The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited, whose voting ordinary shares trade on the NYSE (NTB) and the Bermuda Stock Exchange (NTB.BH); its known 5%-or-more beneficial owners are BlackRock, Inc. (7.1%) and FMR LLC (6.9%) (Form 20-F FY2025). No state or state-fund holder in its chain, and no human-rights finding against the company was found.
